This time includes both on-land instruction and practice on the water.</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-45871" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse45871" aria-controls="collapse45871" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> Do I need previous experience in water sports to take kitesurfing lessons?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse45871" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-45871"> <div class="ea-body"><p>Previous experience in water sports <strong>is not necessary</strong> to take kitesurfing lessons. Our instructors are trained to teach people of all levels, from beginners to advanced.</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-45872" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse45872" aria-controls="collapse45872" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> What is the minimum age to participate in kitesurfing classes?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse45872" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-45872"> <div class="ea-body"><p>Thanks to the new kite designs, safety systems, and teaching methodologies, children can start at <strong>around 7 years old.</strong></p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-45873" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse45873" aria-controls="collapse45873" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> What do I need to bring for kitesurfing classes?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse45873" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-45873"> <div class="ea-body"><p>It is recommended to bring swimwear, sunscreen, drinking water, and comfortable clothing. All necessary kitesurfing equipment will be provided by the school.</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-45874" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse45874" aria-controls="collapse45874" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> Is the equipment important when taking the courses?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse45874" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-45874"> <div class="ea-body"><p>It is very important. We work with <strong>Duotone</strong>, one of the most prestigious brands in the market. We renew the equipment every year so that our students have state-of-the-art gear and offer them the following advantages:</p><ul><li>Safety: modern, effective, and easy-to-use safety systems.</li><li>Stable kites: thanks to their modern designs, the kites are stable and very easy for students to use.</li><li>Strong and durable materials.</li><li>Boards with special dimensions for students to facilitate navigation.</li></ul><p>We also work with <strong>ION</strong>, one of the best brands for accessories (wetsuits, vests, harnesses, helmets).</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-45875" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse45875" aria-controls="collapse45875" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> Can I join a group course if I am alone?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse45875" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-45875"> <div class="ea-body"><p>Group courses are typically for family and friend groups who come together. Exceptionally, if students have the same level and speak the same language, it could be possible.</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-45876" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse45876" aria-controls="collapse45876" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> Can I do a semi-private course if I am alone?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse45876" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-45876"> <div class="ea-body"><p>This service is designed for two people booking together. Exceptionally, if students have the same level and speak the same language, it could be possible.</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-45877" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse45877" aria-controls="collapse45877" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> What happens if the weather conditions are not suitable for kitesurfing lessons?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse45877" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-45877"> <div class="ea-body"><p>If the weather conditions are not suitable for safely conducting kitesurfing lessons, the school may <strong>reschedule the class for another day or provide a full refund.</strong></p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-45878" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse45878" aria-controls="collapse45878" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> What is the cancellation policy for kitesurfing lessons?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse45878" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-45878"> <div class="ea-body"><p>Our cancellation policy varies depending on the circumstances. Typically, we require <strong>at least 24 hours</strong> notice to cancel a lesson without penalty.</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-45879" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse45879" aria-controls="collapse45879" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> Is it a dangerous sport?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse45879" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-45879"> <div class="ea-body"><p>Like any sport, it has its risks; however, caution and our professional instructors minimize them.</p><p>Over the years, with the evolution of equipment, safety systems, and new teaching methodologies, kitesurfing has become an extremely safe sport.</p><p>&nbsp;</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-458710" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse458710" aria-controls="collapse458710" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> How much does a kitesurfing course in Tarifa cost? </a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse458710" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-458710"> <div class="ea-body"><p>At LazyKite we offer group, semi-private, and private lessons. Prices vary depending on the format and duration (1, 3, or 5 days). Visit our courses page or contact us for a personalised quote based on your dates and level.</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-458711" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse458711" aria-controls="collapse458711" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> What does the course price include?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse458711" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-458711"> <div class="ea-body"><p>The price includes all equipment (kite, board, harness, wetsuit), accident insurance, IKO and FAV certified instructors, and your IKO card upon completing the corresponding level.</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-458712" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse458712" aria-controls="collapse458712" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> Is a private course better than a group course?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse458712" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-458712"> <div class="ea-body"><p>It depends on your goal. Private lessons allow you to progress faster and adapt fully to your pace. Group courses are more affordable and offer a great social atmosphere. If you have limited time, we recommend going private.</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-458713" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse458713" aria-controls="collapse458713" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> Do you offer course and accommodation packages?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse458713" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-458713"> <div class="ea-body"><p>Yes. LazyKite has its own Surf House in the centre of Tarifa. You can book a complete package including accommodation and lessons — perfect for a hassle-free kitesurfing holiday.</p></div></div></div><div class="ea-card sp-ea-single"><h3 class="ea-header"><a class="collapsed" id="ea-header-458714" role="button" data-sptoggle="spcollapse" data-sptarget="#collapse458714" aria-controls="collapse458714" href="#" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true" role="presentation" class="ea-expand-icon eap-icon-ea-expand-plus"></i> How many hours do I need to reach the basic level?</a></h3><div class="sp-collapse spcollapse spcollapse" id="collapse458714" data-parent="#sp-ea-4587" role="region" aria-labelledby="ea-header-458714"> <div class="ea-body"><p>Generally, 9 to 12 hours of lessons are enough to reach independent riding level and obtain the basic IKO certification.
